newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: EDP launches 7-yr 1 bln mark loan issue.
newsitem.headline: EDP launches 7-yr 1 bln mark loan issue.

text.p: Portuguese electricity company EDP-Electricidade de Portugal launched a seven-year one billion German mark loan issue at Libor plus 12.5 basis points (bp), an EDP official told Reuters.
"EDP signed a contract yesterday in London for a new seven-year loan issue of one billion (German) marks at Libor plus 12.5 basis points (bp)," the official said.
"These 100 billion escudos are for early payment of previous loans that had less favourable financial conditions and shorter maturities," he added.

"This is a pure financial management operation. There were loans that had been negotiated. Now the market is better, and so we have taken out a new loan to regularise previous loans, so that we will have lower debt service payments," he said.
He added: "With these 100 billion escudos, the debt of EDP is not increasing."
